test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains of the same length are running on parallel tracks in the same direction at 44 km/h and 32 km/h. The faster train passes the other train in 72 seconds. What is the length (in m) of each train?
solution:
**GIven:**

Speed of the two trains is 44 km/h and 32 km/h

**Concept used:**

Distance/Speed = Time

If both the trains are running on parallel tracks in same direction, the distance covered by the fastest train will be length of its and length of the smaller train

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the train be x meters.

Relative speed of fastest train = 44 – 32 = 12 km/hr = 12 × 5/18 = 10/3 m/s. 

According to the question,

2x/10/3 = 72

⇒ x = 120 m

**∴ The length of each train 120 metes.**
